build_generalized_rcnn: build a GeneralizedRCNN model with backbone, proposal generator, and ROI heads from a config
create_proposal_network: create a ProposalNetwork that predicts object proposals using backbone and proposal generator
run_rcnn_inference: run inference on a GeneralizedRCNN model given a list of batched input dictionaries
preprocess_rcnn_images: preprocess images by normalizing with pixel mean/std and batching into an ImageList
visualize_rcnn_training: visualize training by overlaying ground truth and predicted proposals on images
